text_block_list.text:
I'm glad it wasn't anything serious.
Something like this won't hold your running back at all.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Let's head back, Trainer.
To where we belong.

Wordplay like that is fun, but
I don't think we need it right now.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: "...I wonder if that look in your eyes is also what Rudolf called 'something an Umamusume herself could never give rise to.'"

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Understood.
I'll listen to what you say today.

With that, Mr. C.B.
took a proper, well-deserved rest.
I put together a return-to-training regimen designed not to strain her injury, and as we tested it out—

While out on a light run,
Mr. C.B. came to a sudden halt.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
“—It's no use.
The more I run, the more chains wrap around my body, suffocating me.”

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: So this is as far as we go, huh.
With that, Mr. C.B. left the training grounds looking distressed.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Your routine is amazing!
It makes me completely forget I was even injured.
choice_data_list: Overdoing it is a no-go, you hear?
Overdoing it is a no-go, okay?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Ignoring this surge of excitement in my heart? Absolutely unthinkable for me!
And so, by working through her rehabilitation menu, Mr. C.B.'s injury recovered smoothly.
